entity: Vermont private-sale gun background checks under its universal-check law
what_we_add: 77 checks in 2022, 0.17 per 100 dealer checks, last of the 10 law states vs a 2.2 median
why: WCAX and VTDigger name Vermont and state the same finding in words and numbers: private-sale checks stayed tiny (48 in 2017, ~90 in 2018, flat in 2019) despite the law. Their years differ from ours but the finding is the same direction; the 2022 count and 10-state ranking are ours alone.
